title: Bid
description: A manager agent's output for one moment, after the number checker. The explanation goes to that manager's phone; the bid goes to the scorer. The conditional rules here are enforced by the JSON Schema; the generated pydantic and TypeScript types do not enforce them.

urgency.description: The agent's own claim, 0 to 1. The scorer weighs it; it does not decide.

explanation_en.description: English version when lang is not en, for judges and logs (rule 4.9).

pitch_to_host.description: One line arguing for the group screen, and the line the group screen shows if this bid wins: English, about the manager in the third person (#138).

status.description: ok: checked and passed. retried: passed on the one retry. fallback: replaced by the plain stat after a failed check or a timeout. declined: the agent passed on a moment that does not change its manager's points; no phone message, no bid for the screen. Declined bids are not scored: they never appear in a host decision's scores and never reach the group screen.

model.description: Foundry deployment name that produced it.

pitch_source.description: Who wrote pitch_to_host: manager (the agent) or code. code on a plain-stat fallback, and when only the pitch failed its checks twice and code's line replaced it, keeping the agent's explanation (#138). Absent means manager unless status is fallback.

angle.description: The fact from this manager's stake the agent chose to argue with (#88). Checked against the stake in the workflow, not here.
